test_item:
The trusted root and intermediate certificates shall be stored in a persistent, read-only partition that is isolated from user operations.
(trusted certificate chain survives a factory reset and still verifies a leaf)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Test runner CertProviderAndroidInstrumentalTest.apk is installed
3. Certificate assets are available under SecurityAssets/oem-certs/cert-provider/
proc:
1. Confirm the content of /odm/etc/cert_store on the DUT
$ adb shell ls -l /odm/etc/cert_store
2. Run the OpenSSL chain verification of the certificate on the host
$ openssl verify -verbose -CAfile RootCert.pem -untrusted L1.pem -untrusted L2.pem -untrusted L3.pem SAMcert.pem
3. <DUT-side trigger for valid leaf certificate provided by RD (X-e)>
$ <command provided by RD (X-e)>
er:
1. The adb shell ls -l /odm/etc/cert_store output lists the trusted certificate chain files
2. The openssl command prints "SAMcert.pem: OK" on stdout
3. <log keyword provided by RD (X-h)>
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
author: PeiPYHsu
